items.title: 63520_Ernie Fields oral history interview
items.q: I had two brothers, I had twins in the band, Edwin Milton, a trumpet and Edward on trombone.

ctx.x: Yeah. We'd switch between he and Edwin Milton.
I had two brothers, I had twins in the band, Edwin Milton, a trumpet and Edward on trombone.
Edwin would be on first or either Jeff between and Amos would play second or third all the time.
